decision_question: Does a causal forward-looking BTC options volatility floor correct enough of the retained model's short-horizon overconfidence to warrant an independent Polymarket opportunity-level screen?

motivation.measured_failure: The retained strategy's internal probability is more overconfident and less calibrated than the executable market. A causal 15-minute realized-volatility maximum improved public-proxy scores broadly but failed its fixed Brier-magnitude gate.
motivation.distinct_mechanism: Deribit DVOL is a 30-day annualized forward-looking volatility expectation derived from BTC option prices across the smile. It is exogenous to the one-hour backward-looking Binance realized-volatility estimate and is not another half-life, threshold, calibration, or lifecycle variant.
motivation.why_maximum: The candidate is uncertainty-only: it may retain or increase the baseline volatility but never lower it. This directly tests whether options-implied uncertainty can veto overconfident fair values without manufacturing more confidence.
motivation.hypothesis_budget: One formula, one DVOL source, one staleness bound, one pair of disjoint evaluation windows, and no coefficient or threshold grid.

frozen_formula.baseline_annualized_volatility: max(0.30, causal rolling-one-hour Binance BTCUSDT close-to-close realized volatility)
frozen_formula.dvol_sample: last Deribit btcdvol_usdc index-chart observation with timestamp less than or equal to the forecast decision timestamp
frozen_formula.missing_or_stale_dvol: forecast is ineligible; no fallback or imputation
frozen_formula.normal_cdf: exact vectorization of rust_engine/src/fair_value.rs Abramowitz-Stegun 7.1.26 implementation

public_data_contract.binance_source: Official Binance public BTCUSDT spot one-second kline daily archives and adjacent SHA-256 checksum files
public_data_contract.deribit_source: Deribit public/get_index_chart_data for index_name=btcdvol_usdc and range=1y
excluded_known_strategy_or_proxy_windows: 2026-07-14T15:00:00Z through 2026-07-15T08:50:00Z retained fresh and settlement-anchor captures
all active or sealed forward-block conditions
public_data_contract.five_minute_window_alignment: UTC Unix timestamps divisible by 300 seconds
public_data_contract.strike: open price of the first one-second Binance kline in the five-minute window
public_data_contract.causal_spot: close price of the one-second kline ending at or before the registered decision offset
public_data_contract.terminal_label: last one-second close before the five-minute boundary is greater than the registered strike; exact ties are excluded

frozen_estimands.primary_grain: one forecast per five-minute condition and registered decision offset with fresh causal DVOL
secondary_metrics: Brier and log loss for baseline probabilities at least 0.75 or at most 0.25
frozen_estimands.uncertainty: Paired block bootstrap by UTC day with 10000 deterministic resamples and seed 20260721
frozen_estimands.comparison_sign: positive baseline-minus-candidate proper-score deltas favor the candidate

decision_rules.pass: Register one default-off opportunity-capture field and require an independent Polymarket opportunity-level screen before exact strategy replay or runtime implementation.
decision_rules.fail: Reject dvol_volatility_max_v1 and do not tune the source, staleness, maximum operator, floor, dates, decision offsets, or score thresholds on these windows.
decision_rules.inconclusive: Treat missing, stale, mutable, or invalid public source data as a failed research screen; do not substitute the active forward block or lower a gate.
